relationships.subject: Phlomidis Radix extract

relationships.subject: Phlomidis Radix extract
relationships.evidence_quote: The results show that 300 and 500 mg/kg, but not 100 mg/kg of P.Radix extracts alleviate both types of pain induced by paclitaxel.

relationships.subject: sesamoside
relationships.evidence_quote: spinal TRPV1 gene expression was significantly downregulated in the 7.5 mg/kg but not the 5 mg/kg treated group mice

key_findings: Phlomidis Radix extract dose-dependently relieved paclitaxel-induced cold and mechanical hypersensitivity in mice.
Paclitaxel increased spinal TRPV1 and TRPM4 but not TRPA1; the extract and its component sesamoside reduced spinal TRPV1.
